description: Placement painting (packages/core/docs/placement-painting.md §3): what a creator painted into a world — what, where, in which form, by which gesture — and, before any of it lands, whether the world knows what is being painted and knows the place it is going. Each kb mirrors packages/core/src/placement/placement-predicates.ts verbatim and is regenerated by `npm run placement-corpus`. The pack is a COMPOSITION pack over the ENTITY and PLACE vocabularies: it reads item/1, person/1, entity_id/2, place_position/3, region/1, lot/1 and settlement/1 and defines clauses for none of them, and the cases here declare every adopted predicate dynamic themselves, exactly as the shipped pack does, which is what lets them run standalone. The negatives carry the file: placement_paintable/2 is a PERMISSION ON AN EDIT, and an implementation that answered yes to every one of them passes every positive case here while letting an editor put an oak that does not exist in a village that does not exist — which is exactly what nothing was checking before this area existed. What is NOT here is a coordinate: where a painted node stands in metres is the scene manifest's (packages/core/src/editor/scene/placement.ts, quantized and re-import matched), and a second copy of a transform is a transform free to disagree with the first. Neither is the schema gate over a stroke's delta, which is TypeScript and is proved in packages/core/src/game-engine/logic/__tests__/PlacementPainter.test.ts against a real KB.

cases.name: a-bare-kb-has-nothing-painted-in-it-and-does-not-raise
kb: placement_length([_ | T], N) :- placement_length(T, N0), N is N0 + 1.
placement_paintable(S, P) :- nonvar(S), nonvar(P), placement_subject(S), placement_place(P).
placement_at(Prop, Place) :- placement_painted(I, Prop, Place), placement_present(I).
placement_density(Prop, Place, N) :- nonvar(Prop), nonvar(Place), findall(I, (placement_painted(I, Prop, Place), placement_present(I)), Is), placement_length(Is, N).
placement_misvaried(I) :- placement_variation(I, V), placement_painted(I, Prop, _), \+ placement_prop_variation(Prop, V).
